comparison.objective: Remove a processor blade safely and pour walnuts; candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Straight axial extraction under jamming constraints followed by controlled pouring versus countertorque locking.
comparison.success_condition: Walnuts transferred with blade safely stowed versus retained opening accuracy and functional cycling.
comparison.reason: The record tests hazardous-part removal and pouring, not mechanical setting preservation.
